After approval to test, create isolated scenarios for: both profiles in all six ages; controller and independent modes; multiple State Bank selector candidates; one-bank inheritance; 32 deposit slot exhaustion; term maturity/reload; zero-cash withdrawal queue; 98-basis/100-face native resale; stale offer generation and changed holder; 10 physical goods versus two 8-unit receipts; mixed owner dividends; company retained versus direct-overlord income; dead party references; old-controller removal; native default followed by one loss recognition; notes with issuance cash excluded; and a sovereign/two-bank integrated bond flow.

Native Fugger/Welser founding events may help establish a bank fixture, but never modify historical founding scripts merely to provide a second startup cash grant. Debug fixture creation and console events are in-game testing and have not been run.
